coverageAnalysis_comment: perTest cannot attribute module-level mutants (regexes, tables, const arrow functions) to the test that runs them, so a handful are reported as survivors that the suite actually kills — measured by hand: with `normalise` in authorization.ts replaced by the identity, two tests fail. Read the survivors in those files as hints, not as untested paths; `ignoreStatic` would hide them from the number instead of from the report, which is worse.
